scripts.web:generate: openapi-typescript api/openapi/public.yaml -o web-shared/src/generated/public.ts && openapi-typescript api/openapi/web-edge.yaml -o web-shared/src/generated/web-edge.ts && openapi-typescript api/openapi/oauth-public.yaml -o web-shared/src/generated/oauth-public.ts
scripts.web:build: pnpm web:generate && pnpm --filter @agentserver/v2-platform-web build && pnpm --filter @agentserver/v2-browser-web build && pnpm web:normalize
scripts.web:typecheck: pnpm --filter @agentserver/v2-web-shared typecheck && pnpm --filter @agentserver/v2-platform-web typecheck && pnpm --filter @agentserver/v2-browser-web typecheck
scripts.web:test: pnpm --filter @agentserver/v2-web-shared test && pnpm --filter @agentserver/v2-platform-web test && pnpm --filter @agentserver/v2-browser-web test
scripts.web:check: pnpm web:generate && pnpm web:typecheck && pnpm web:test && pnpm web:build
